result.title: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
result.summary: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

AI.brief_summary: GeLiFiSH 提出一种无需学习的 LiDAR 关键点滤波方法，在滚动体素图上做高度-结构检测，用位置、协方差与存在概率初始化轨迹，并以序贯概率比检验递归地接受或剔除跨帧关键点，同时借助地面分割与运动物体分割提供无传感器先验的高度参考并去除动态点。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以存在概率维护持久状态、用序贯概率比检验淘汰由动态物体鬼影造成的伪观测」可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 的保留/剔除与停止判断提供可核查的类比线索，但领域为 3D 配准，跨模态迁移尚属推测。
